summary: Build the higher layer from explicit pipeline stages, trustworthy evidence and deliberate context boundaries while preserving drill-down.

items.text: Fence agents behind platform-owned task history, authority and evidence so aggregate management signals remain independently inspectable.
Represent work as versioned stages, triggers and pass criteria before managing pipeline flow or capacity.
Use explicit task boundaries when a move between implementation and management also changes the operator's active topic.
Use named, structured gate verdicts as drill-down evidence behind higher-level quality signals.
Document system behavior and rationale so operators can make accountable decisions above individual code changes.
